dashboard-intro.title: Your Command Center
dashboard-intro.description: This is your dashboard — a quick overview of your clients, cases, tasks, and revenue. Everything you need to know at a glance.

sidebar-clients.title: Navigate to Clients
sidebar-clients.description: In Organia, everything starts with a client. Click on 'Clients' in the sidebar to see your client list.
sidebar-clients.action: Click on Clients in the sidebar

create-client.title: Add Your First Client
create-client.description: Now let's add your first client. This is where all your legal work begins.

phase1-complete.title: Great Start!
phase1-complete.description: You've learned the basics! You now know how to navigate and add clients. Ready to learn about dossiers?

client-detail-intro.title: Inside a Client
client-detail-intro.description: You're inside a client's profile. Everything related to this person lives here — their dossiers, tasks, hearings, and finances.

client-dossiers-tab.title: Open Dossiers Tab
client-dossiers-tab.description: Let's see this client's dossiers. Click on the Dossiers tab to view and create legal matters.

create-dossier-from-client.title: Create a Dossier
create-dossier-from-client.description: A dossier represents a real legal matter. Let's create one for this client.

client-notification-intro.title: Smart Client Communication
client-notification-intro.description: Organia detects important data and helps you send it to your client. New dossiers, status changes, upcoming hearings — the app prompts you when something matters. You stay in control.
client-notification-intro.action: Choose to send or skip the notification

dossier-detail-overview.title: The Heart of Your Work
dossier-detail-overview.description: This is a dossier — the core of your legal work. Tasks, missions, hearings, and finances all attach here. Everything stays organized in one place.

sidebar-dossiers.title: The Global View
sidebar-dossiers.description: You can also manage dossiers globally. Click on 'Dossiers' to see all dossiers across all clients.
sidebar-dossiers.action: Click on Dossiers in the sidebar

dossiers-list-overview.title: Two Valid Paths
dossiers-list-overview.description: Here's the same dossier, visible globally. You can create dossiers from here too — both paths are valid. Choose what feels natural.

phase2-complete.title: Dossier Mastery!
phase2-complete.description: You now understand dossiers — the heart of your legal work. You know how to create them from a client or from the global list. Ready to learn about tasks?

select-dossier-for-tasks.title: Open a Dossier
select-dossier-for-tasks.description: Now let's learn about tasks. First, click on any dossier to open its detail view.
select-dossier-for-tasks.action: Click on a dossier to open it

dossier-tasks-tab.title: Your To-Do List
dossier-tasks-tab.description: Tasks are how work gets done. Each dossier has its own task list. Let's see what needs to be done.

create-task-from-dossier.title: Create a Task
create-task-from-dossier.description: Add a task with a deadline and priority. Stay on top of your workload.

task-detail-overview.title: Task Details
task-detail-overview.description: Here's your task. You can set priority, due date, and assign it to team members. Everything is tracked.

task-status-workflow.title: Track Progress
task-status-workflow.description: Tasks flow from 'To Do' → 'In Progress' → 'Done'. Update the status as you work. Your dashboard shows what's pending.

sidebar-personal-tasks.title: Personal Tasks
sidebar-personal-tasks.description: Not everything belongs to a dossier. Personal tasks are for your own reminders — calls, admin work, follow-ups.

personal-tasks-overview.title: Your Private List
personal-tasks-overview.description: These are YOUR tasks — not linked to any dossier. Perfect for personal reminders and admin work.

phase3-complete.title: Task Master!
phase3-complete.description: You now know how to manage tasks — both for dossiers and personal ones. Next, let's explore hearings and sessions.

sidebar-sessions.title: Court Sessions
sidebar-sessions.description: Sessions are your court appearances — hearings, meetings, and appointments. Let's see how to manage them.

sessions-list-overview.title: Your Calendar
sessions-list-overview.description: All your scheduled sessions appear here. Each session is linked to a dossier or case, so context is never lost.

create-session.title: Schedule a Session
create-session.description: Add a court hearing or meeting. Set the date, time, location, and link it to your case.

session-detail-overview.title: Session Details
session-detail-overview.description: Track the outcome, notes, and next steps for each session. Everything is documented for future reference.

phase4-complete.title: Session Pro!
phase4-complete.description: You can now manage court sessions and hearings. Next, let's learn about officers and missions — your execution network.

sidebar-officers.title: Meet the Officers
sidebar-officers.description: Officers (huissiers) are the professionals who execute missions for you — serving documents, collecting debts, etc.

officers-list-overview.title: Your Officer Network
officers-list-overview.description: Here you manage your list of bailiffs and officers. You'll need at least one officer before creating missions.

missions-workflow-explained.title: How Missions Work
missions-workflow-explained.description: Missions are billable work done by officers. Create them from a dossier, link to an officer, and track the outcome. When complete, fees flow to your finances.

phase5-complete.title: Mission Expert!
phase5-complete.description: You understand officers and missions. Now let's see where all this comes together — your finances.

sidebar-accounting.title: Your Finances
sidebar-accounting.description: The Accounting section shows your complete financial picture — income, expenses, and balances.

financial-overview.title: Financial Dashboard
financial-overview.description: See your earnings at a glance. Mission fees, client payments, and expenses — all in one place.

financial-entries-explained.title: Track Every Dinar
financial-entries-explained.description: Each financial entry is linked to its source — a mission, a payment, or an expense. Full traceability, always.

phase6-complete.title: Financial Clarity!
phase6-complete.description: You now understand how Organia tracks your money. One more step to complete your training!

tutorial-complete.title: 🎉 Congratulations!
tutorial-complete.description: You've completed the Organia tutorial! You now know how to manage clients, dossiers, tasks, sessions, missions, and finances. You're ready to run your practice like a pro.

completion.title: Tutorial Paused
completion.description: You can resume or restart the tutorial anytime from Settings.

prompt.title: Ready to Learn?
prompt.description: Would you like a quick guided tour of Organia? We'll show you how to navigate the app and create your first client.
prompt.laterNote: You can always start the tutorial later from Settings.

settings.startDescription: Learn by doing with a step-by-step guided tour.
